title: Homesick People Here Shrink An INCH A Day 🏠
description:
If you're homesick in our town, you shrink an inch a day, until someone from home hugs you. Everyone knows it. Mr. Pratt next door can ride his own ball return now.

We moved across town in June, and Mom keeps saying it isn't home yet. So every morning I pencil her height on the doorframe, just to check.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: When did Mom know it was Leo: the doorknobs, the sweaters, or the chair?
